description: This header file declares functions related to MKL-DNN (oneDNN) optimized convolution operations in the ATen native namespace, including pointwise and transpose convolutions with optional binary and unary variants.

methods.name: mkldnn_convolution_pointwise
methods.description: Performs an MKL-DNN optimized pointwise convolution with optional scalar parameters.

methods.name: mkldnn_convolution_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Performs a binary pointwise convolution with additional parameters for binary and unary attributes.

methods.name: mkldnn_convolution_pointwise_binary_
methods.description: In-place version of binary pointwise convolution function, modifies the 'other_t' tensor.

methods.name: mkldnn_convolution_transpose_pointwise
methods.description: Performs an MKL-DNN optimized transposed pointwise convolution.
